summary: This document adds an option to the Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) letting a client and server agree on a window size, so several data blocks can be sent before an acknowledgment is needed. This speeds up transfers over the otherwise lockstep protocol.

eli5.summary: TFTP sends one piece, then waits to hear back. This option lets it send several pieces before waiting, like handing over a stack of pages instead of one at a time.
